name: Memory Charm, Greater
body:
Price 4,000 gp; Slot —; CL 10th; Weight —; Aura moderate enchantment

DESCRIPTION

A greater memory charm functions as a lesser memory charm but implants a false memory in place of the creature’s true memory of acquiring the item, rather than simply causing her to forget the item’s provenance (DC 16 Will negates).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 2,000 gp; Spells bestow curse, modify memory
